defects.title: The default environment CPython3 rejects every Python newer than 3.8
defects.trigger: initPythonEnvironment() with python3 3.12.3 on the system path (MATLAB R2025a)
defects.observed: error 'MATLAB >=R2020b is only stated to be compatible with Python 3.6,3.7,3.8' at line 123 (line 120 tests contains(response,'3.6')||'3.7'||'3.8' on 'python3 --version'); in the same session pyenv('Version', <which python3>, 'ExecutionMode', 'OutOfProcess') loads Python 3.12 and py.sys.version returns '3.12.3 ...'
defects.expected: the Python versions supported by the running MATLAB are accepted (R2025a: 3.9-3.12; R2023b and later no longer support 3.8), so the default option can load Python

notes: Reproduction (fresh MATLAB R2025a, python3 3.12.3): initCobraToolbox(false); try, initPythonEnvironment(); catch ME, disp(ME.message), disp(ME.stack(1).line), end  -> message above, line 123; then [~, pyExe] = system('which python3'); pe = pyenv('Version', strtrim(pyExe), 'ExecutionMode', 'OutOfProcess'); char(py.sys.version) -> '3.12.3 (main, ...)'. The call leaves PATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH unchanged when they hold no anaconda3/envs entry. Other branches probed: initPythonEnvironment('CPython2') prints the apt-get hint and errors at line 113 (no python2); initPythonEnvironment('base') errors at line 61 (no anaconda). Not reproducible here (no conda), for a later reviewer: line 198 builds '<anaconda>/env<name>/bin' (missing 'envs' and a filesep; line 202 uses 'envs'), and line 208 passes extra text arguments to error without format specifiers. Callers that reach the defect with the default CPython3: src/base/io/python/cobrapy/writeModelinJSON.m, src/analysis/thermo/groupContribution/wang/autoFragment.m (check their call forms). py_rmpath is called with MATLAB_too = 0 only (not the quarantined form).
confirmed_by: lead (source read: the version check at lines 118-124 runs only in the case 'CPython3' branch, the default environment; it rejects python3 3.12, which this R2025a session loads without trouble)
